source.title: Confessor's Unshakable Ornament — Wowhead indexed cumulative Looter disenchanting table
source.author: Wowhead Looter (aggregated player submissions)

notes: Indexed Wowhead Looter aggregate for exactly gear item 229331 (cloth waist (Priest), patch 11.1.0-origin gear), displayed row 1/3. All three distinct source rows share the same 82 item-specific reported disenchant-operation denominator; do NOT sum row hits as mutually exclusive disenchants or interpret remainder as zero-yield operations. Source displays three identically named Refulgent Crystal rows without resolvable rank/item-ID links. Keep row identity and order distinct, outputItemID/outputRank unknown, and never aggregate same-name quality variants. Source count 'out of' is per-output occurrence/hit count, NOT material-unit total or 0/1/2+ stack histogram; zero outcomes are not evidenced. Collector dataDate/client patch, actual disenchanted bonus/item level, quality variant, skill/specialization and Resourcefulness/refund basis not reported. On-page item level and expansion-added patch do not establish logged source era. Original Wowhead JS table not independently exported; numbers cross-checked in search-indexed source table. Research-only; unverified live-eligibility, no gold EV.
